name: particle bomb (single vertex)
description: Single 'particle bomb' interaction per event (no pile-up). Draws a per-event multiplicity N=Uniform(1,5), then samples N particles (with replacement) from the candidate pool {e-, e+, mu-, mu+, pi+, pi-, pi0}. Kinetic energies are uniform in [1, 2000] MeV for electrons and [200, 2000] MeV for the rest, isotropic direction. Same physics as config_18 but with a single vertex.

trigger._note: HK high-E real trigger — validated on muons (muon 99.9%, Michel 99.4% hits kept, 0 dark windows) and config_18 pile-up (99.97% physics hits kept, 0 dark windows)
